details: For every integer $k\geq0$, $\mathrm{RL}^{\mathrm{mist}}_k(\mathcal H)\geq\frac12\mathrm L^{\mathrm{mist}}_k(\mathcal H).
proof: A k-shattered tree of minimum branch length d has random-branch expectation at least d. It therefore witnesses randomized k-mistake Littlestone dimension at least d/2; take the supremum over d.
proof_source: Immediate from the two k-shattered-tree definitions in Section 2.2.1 of \cite{filmus2023randomized}.
name: Randomized $k$-Mistake Littlestone Dimension / $k$-Mistake Littlestone Dimension
